requirements.statement: Developers should be able to integrate plugin tools through verified API/SDK contracts.
acceptance: Invalid SDK input returns a typed refusal.
requirements.falsifier: Tool accepts invalid input without refusal.

requirements.statement: Support host-owned plugin create, test, publish, update and share phases without granting public CLI effects.
acceptance: A publish proposal without provider readback remains NOT_STARTED.
requirements.falsifier: A local fixture is reported as a published plugin.

requirements.statement: Represent declared ChatGPT, Codex and interactive app compatibility without assuming runtime parity.
acceptance: Unknown host compatibility is not marked verified.
requirements.falsifier: A spec shape pass is reported as verified cross-product runtime parity.

requirements.statement: Make MCP and other open-standard contract versions explicit at integration boundaries.
acceptance: Missing protocol version cannot become an executable integration claim.
requirements.falsifier: An LLM guesses SDK or MCP compatibility from a repository name.

requirements.statement: Bind developer and partner feedback to a decision source and its human review owner.
acceptance: Suggested interview answers remain WAIT_FOR_HUMAN without real reviewer input.
requirements.falsifier: The agent accepts its own recommendation as a partner decision.

requirements.statement: Keep permissions, safety checks and reliable execution evidence under original host and provider owners.
acceptance: An unregistered or unauthorized ActionRequest never has can_execute true.
requirements.falsifier: A schema readiness decision grants PR merge or provider write authority.

cards.title: Draft tool contract
cards.payload: A structured tool request should validate required fields and deny unauthenticated invocation. This is a draft, not a tested API.

cards.title: Plugin lifecycle contract
cards.payload: Plugin lifecycle operations are named proposals; only an authorized host may publish or update a plugin.

cards.title: Consumer compatibility contract
cards.payload: Each host declares supported capabilities and its independent verification receipt; absent evidence is an explicit gap.

cards.title: Open standard version contract
cards.payload: A host adapter must pin protocol and schema revisions before any standard-conformance claim.

cards.title: Developer feedback contract
cards.payload: Feedback is traceable input and cannot become a confirmed decision without a trusted human source.

cards.title: Permission and owner contract
cards.payload: FactoryWeaver proposes typed actions; host owners separately validate effects and delivery.

subject.scope: illustrative six-clause proposal, unpinned source, human/runtime proof absent
